```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Alyssa/Single_Cell_CHIP_Vascular/")
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
hatim_to_vantage_map = read_excel("input_data/hatim_to_vantage_ids.xlsx")
hatim_chip_results = read_xlsx("input_data/HIV_CHIP_assay_6902.xlsx", sheet = "CHIP")
```

```{r}
hatim_ids_used = c("5002", "5003", "5005", "5009", "5012", "5013", "5015", "5016", "5017", "5018", "5020", "5022", "5024", "5027", "5029", "5030", "5031", "5032", "5033", "5034", "5036", "5037", "5038", "5008", "5010", "5011", "5021", "5028", "5001", "5004", "5019")
```

```{r}
hatim_to_variants_map = hatim_to_vantage_map %>%
  mutate(HATIM_ID = substr(`Sample Description`, 7, 10)) %>%
  filter(HATIM_ID %in% hatim_ids_used) %>%
  left_join(hatim_chip_results, by = c(`VANTAGE ID` = "Sample")) %>%
  select(HATIM_ID, transcriptOI, Accession, AF)
```
